_comment: RIGHTBREED v4 — G6 daily-schedule risk gate. DRAFT, PENDING VET SIGN-OFF.
WEAKEST-EVIDENCED gate in the engine, and deliberately the smallest bite —
kept that way on explicit instruction. No peer-reviewed study validates a
breed-specific 'safe hours alone' figure for ANY breed (see the Gap
Research file's own methodology sheet). What exists: RSPCA/PDSA/Dogs
Trust/Blue Cross converge on a flat 4-hour welfare ceiling that does NOT
vary by breed — that ceiling is shown as a universal disclaimer at 8+ hrs
regardless of tier or breed, separate from this gate's math. The tier below
Source / Confidence column, Gap Research file) — max penalty capped at
0.90, roughly half the bite of G4/G5's worst case.
Every breed in breeds.json must appear in `breeds` or the build FAILS
(scripts/validate-data.mjs). Multipliers apply to the base score:
final = base x G1 x G2 x G3 x G4 x G5 x G6.

classReasons.AVERAGE: no strong behavioural-literature signal either way
classReasons.INDEPENDENT: widely described (non-peer-reviewed) as independent / higher solo tolerance
